Name: HxW Ripley's Country Kitchen
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[size=5]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RflYybl.png[/img][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xOnA2oQ.png[/img]
[/size]
[size=4][center][b]Inspired by simple country kitchens, this set of mods allows you to do the following:[/b][/center]
1. The[b] kitchen replacement version [/b]will re-texture your existing in game kitchen.
2. The[b] buildable version[/b] is NEW furniture that allows you to make the country kitchen of your dreams, with counters, islands a working stove and more! Since these counters are considered tables, it also allows you to further decorate your kitchen by placing things onto your newly made kitchen islands and counters. Exciting!
3. The [b]AT mod[/b] allows for mini fridges to get re-textured to match the new fridge style. We'd love to make y'all custom fridges but those are...way harder than we had hoped for. So Alternative Textures to the rescue!

So when you download this mod you will see THREE mod folders. You can remove the ones you do not wish to use, but be sure to know WHAT it is you are deleting before doing so.

[b][center]Where can I get this new modular kitchen furniture?[/center][/b]
You can either use a mod like CJB Item Spawner or you can access it via your base game furniture catalogue. We may add a custom kitchen catalogue in the future like our other mods, but for now we will keep it simple because wildflour's getting over a back injury and wants to publish this mod hehe.
[i]
NOTE: Currently the rotations of a few of the edge items (like the right edge of the island or counters) don't display items quite right. We are working on it so just don't place things there yet or just be chill with it being a bit off center XD[/i]

[b]Other mods used in screenshots:[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20011]Cozy Chocolate Furniture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20013]Walls and Floors[/url] by Skellady
Floral Window and Some Artisan Goods from Lumisteria's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mt Vapius[/url]
Other Artisan Goods are a mix of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22728]WAG[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia[/url]!
[/size]
[b][size=6]How to Configure this Mod:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Be sure to install the mod and all dependencies[/size]
[*][size=3]Load up the game.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open Generic Mod Config Menu and Select "Ripley's Country Kitchen Replacement" or "Ripley's Modular Kitchen" and choose your desired color schemes[/size]
[/list][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img] [/b]

[size=3]This mod is for SDV 1.6 - in theory the replacement version of the kitchen COULD work with older versions of the game, but it is untested. [b]

It is untested for mobile or multiplayer.[/b] though if all the same mods are installed, multiplayer should be fine. 

I cannot troubleshoot mobile; multiplayer your best bet is to try the SDV modded game support discord channel as it is often too hard for me to diagnose the issue across multiplayer saves. 
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DhwwHA2.png[/img]
